tagline: Device source research and AI build-log diagnosis
description: Read-only assistant. Verifies public device branches and diagnoses logs using optional local Ollama. Does not build, edit or flash devices.
author: Novi

tips.before_install: Existing folders are read-only. Local AI downloads its model on first installation; 2 GB RAM limit. Access key is saved in /DATA/AppData/novi-flowos-assistant/access-key.

title: Novi FlowOS Assistant
